```{r}
xtra_grid = mutate(xtra_rootscsv, volXtra = "placeholder") # made a column called volXtra

head(xtra_grid)

for (i in 1:length(xtra_grid$Extraction_ID)) {
  if ((xtra_grid$A[i]) == "x") {
    xtra_grid$volXtra[i] = "A"
  } else if ((xtra_grid$B[i]) == "x") {
    xtra_grid$volXtra[i] = "B"
  } else if ((xtra_grid$C[i]) == "x") {
    xtra_grid$volXtra[i] = "C"
  } else if ((xtra_grid$D[i]) == "x") {
    xtra_grid$volXtra[i] = "D"
  } else if ((xtra_grid$E[i]) == "x") {
    xtra_grid$volXtra[i] = "E"
  }
}
head(xtra_grid)

xtra_grid = xtra_grid %>% # make a copy of xtra_grid, with the following changes:
  select(c(Box.dated, Extraction_ID, volXtra)) # only keep the columns with these names!
      # the c() makes a "vector" (basically, a list) of all the columns we're keeping. you wouldn't need it if you were just keeping one column.

head(xtra_grid)

xtra_grid = xtra_grid %>%
  filter(Box.dated != "totals: ") %>%
  filter(Box.dated != "percents:")

```
Join the main metadata table with the extra root volumes
```{r}
xtra_grid$Extraction_ID <- as.character(xtra_grid$Extraction_ID) # 

Joint_table = left_join(metadatacsv,xtra_grid,by = "Extraction_ID")
```

check for joining errors:
```{r}
quality_check = Joint_table %>% # make a copy of Joint_table, with the following modifications:
  select(c(Extraction_ID, date_ground_english, volXtra, Box.dated)) # just look at these columns 

# View(quality_check) # ok this looks good, but I think we lost one of the two 39s in the xtra grounds sheet and I don't know which one. re-trying with full_join
```

resolving join errors
```{r}
# There were two Extraction_ID 39s in the extra grounds sheet; based on dates, one of them is actually 59 (which is otherwise absent from that sheet.) Verified by looking in freezer on 11 August 2026, EF and AG.
  # So we know that #59 has "A" volXtra and is in Box.dated 5 December, 2025

Joint_table = Joint_table %>%
  filter(!(Extraction_ID == "39" & Box.dated == "5 December 2025")) %>%
  mutate(volXtra = case_when(
    Extraction_ID == "59" ~ "A",
    .default = volXtra
  )) %>%
    mutate(Box.dated = case_when(
    Extraction_ID == "59" ~ "5 December 2025",
    .default = Box.dated
  ))
  
```

Remove all columns where extraction id isn't numeric, make all extraciton ids numeric
```{r}
Joint_table = Joint_table %>%
  mutate(Extraction_ID = as.numeric(Extraction_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Extraction_ID))
```

Which extraction IDs have been diluted, and how many times? And how much of the original volume is left now?

this chunk has bugs; AG wrote most of it and gemini wrote some
```{r}
LP_summary <- LP_progress %>%

  group_by(Extraction_ID) %>%
  summarize(
    # 1. Your original summary metrics
    dilutions_completed = sum(!is.na(Date_DNA_Dilution)),
    LP_sucessful = case_when(
      any(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)` == "Y", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Y",
      any(is.na(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)`)) ~ "TBD",
      all(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)` == "N", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "N",
      TRUE ~ "TBD"
    ),
    
    # 2. Concatenate all remaining original columns
    across(
      -c(Date_DNA_Dilution, `Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)`), 
      ~ paste(na.omit(unique(.x)), collapse = "; ")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Extraction_ID = as.numeric(Extraction_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Extraction_ID))


Joint_w_dil_progress = Joint_w_dil %>% left_join(LP_summary, by = "Extraction_ID") %>%
  mutate(ul_used_for_dilutions = dilutions_completed * round_original) %>%
  mutate(remaining_original_ul = remaining_original_ul - ul_used_for_dilutions)
```

this version is gemini, based on my original, w a few edits from me
```{r}
LP_summary <- LP_progress %>%
  group_by(Extraction_ID) %>%
  summarize(
    dilutions_completed = sum(!is.na(Date_DNA_Dilution)),
    LP_sucessful = case_when(
      any(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)` == "Y", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Y",
      all(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)` == "N", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "N",
      .default = "TBD",
      .unmatched = "default"
    ),
    
    # Only paste character/text columns to prevent turning numbers into strings
    across(
      where(is.character) & -c(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)`), 
      ~ paste(na.omit(unique(.x)), collapse = "; ")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Extraction_ID = readr::parse_number(as.character(Extraction_ID))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Extraction_ID))


Joint_w_dil_progress <- Joint_w_dil %>% 
  mutate(
    Extraction_ID = readr::parse_number(as.character(Extraction_ID)),
    round_original = as.numeric(round_original) # Ensure numeric type before join
  ) %>%
  left_join(LP_summary, by = "Extraction_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    ul_used_for_dilutions = dilutions_completed * round_original,
    remaining_original_ul = remaining_original_ul - ul_used_for_dilutions
  )
```

```{r}
LP_summary <- LP_progress %>%
  group_by(Extraction_ID) %>%
  summarize(
    dilutions_completed = sum(!is.na(Date_DNA_Dilution)),
    LP_sucessful = case_when(
      any(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)` == "Y", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Y",
      all(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)` == "N", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "N",
      .default = "TBD",
      .unmatched = "default"
    ),
    
    # Explicitly concatenate Date_DNA_Dilution and other columns
    across(
      -c(`Sucsesfull-prep_(Y/N)`), 
      ~ paste(na.omit(unique(as.character(.x))), collapse = "; ")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Extraction_ID = readr::parse_number(as.character(Extraction_ID))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Extraction_ID))


Joint_w_dil_progress <- Joint_w_dil %>% 
  # Drop overlapping columns from Joint_w_dil so left_join doesn't create .x / .y suffixes
  select(-any_of(c("Date_DNA_Dilution", "LP_sucessful", "dilutions_completed"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Extraction_ID = readr::parse_number(as.character(Extraction_ID)),
    round_original = as.numeric(round_original),
    remaining_original_ul = as.numeric(remaining_original_ul)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    select(LP_summary, -any_of(c("round_original", "remaining_original_ul"))), 
    by = "Extraction_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ul_used_for_dilutions = dilutions_completed * round_original,
    remaining_original_ul = remaining_original_ul - ul_used_for_dilutions
  )
```




```{r}
Extra_inventory = Joint_w_dil_progress %>%
  select(c(Extraction_ID, volXtra, remaining_original_ul, dilutions_completed, LP_sucessful, Prep_ID, Date_DNA_Dilution)) %>%
  arrange(volXtra) %>%
  arrange(remaining_original_ul)

nonrepeatable_or_thin_ice = Extra_inventory %>%
  filter(remaining_original_ul < 25) %>%
  filter(volXtra == "A")
```
